IncidentDef.label: void seam
IncidentDef.letterText: The ground has split open into a mouth. Something unimaginably large lies beneath the crust, and it has opened up to be fed. Warm, sweet breath rolls out of it, flesh is creeping across the ground around it, and your heavier colonists feel strangely drawn to it.\n\nAnyone Chubby or heavier can climb down into the void maze: one long, living gut where weight grows freely and void gluttonium can be gathered. The way home lies at the far end, and whoever reaches it in time comes back with a haul. Linger too long and the maze pushes you out empty-handed - or tears something loose. Fleshbeasts, maws and spitting organs lurk in the warm dark.
